model.note: Backtest: 32 property-company landlords that entered administration, liquidation, receivership or a CVA since 2016, versus 420 healthy property landlords checked over the same dates; signals counted in the 2 years before the event (final month ignored). Score 4+ caught 34% of failures while flagging 1% of healthy landlords; 3+ caught 50% while flagging 2.6%. Base rate 0.44% per 2 years, so roughly 1 in 8 score-4+ landlords enter formal insolvency within 2 years. Small in-sample test: a ranking, not a probability.
model.lead: Accounts typically go overdue about 5 months before the insolvency starts; director exits and office moves show about 9 months before.
model.lender: 25% of failed property landlords had a live Together Commercial Finance charge vs 7% of healthy ones.
